{{Quote|Get those mortars up here!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]|<ref name="Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>}}
A '''mortar''', also known as a '''mortar launcher''' or '''mortar cannon''', was an indirect fire weapon that lobbed explosive projectiles known as mortar bombs or shells in a high arc.

==Description==
The mortar launcher was popular with military and insurgent groups due to its low cost and ease of use. The weapon consisted of a tube, a tripod, a magazine, as well as a powerful [[Electromagnet/Legends|electromagnet]] at the base that launched the shells. Also included was an integrated targeting [[Computer/Legends|computer]] which compensated for wind and other environmental factors. A magazine held 5 shells, which the launcher could reload and fire automatically until the magazine was depleted. Alternatively, a soldier could manually load the mortars one at a time, at which point the mortar launcher would fire it. The damage caused by mortar shells was very similar to the damage caused by [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]].<ref name="GaW" />

Because the weapon launched mortars very high into the air, it was ideal for use against long-range targets behind cover. However, this also meant that the mortars could not be fired at targets closer than 75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="GaW" />

The mortar launcher weighed 20 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and cost 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but was available for military use only.<ref name="GaW" />

Some mortars were powerful enough to destroy vehicles.<ref name="GB" />

===Variants===
The mortar launcher could also be mounted on a vehicle and be used as a mobile [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]]. The [[MobileMortar-3]] combined the [[MM-s3 grenade launcher]] and [[WW-676 repulsorlift sled]] to create a such a mobile artillery weapon.

Vehicles such as [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT walkers]] and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcer]] were equipped with mortar cannons.<ref name="BFII:POGG">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] used these weapons during a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|battle]] on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] to attack what they believed to be [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] that were dressed up as [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], when in actuality, they were other [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]].<ref name="Krell" />

Specialized infantry of many factions used mortars to shoot [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. This included the [[Thermal detonator trooper (Galactic Empire)|Imperial thermal detonator trooper]], the [[Thermal detonator trooper (Rebel Alliance)|Rebel thermal detonator trooper]], the [[Grenadier (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|Royal Naboo thermal detonator trooper]], the [[Grenade droid/Legends|Trade Federation thermal detonator battle droid]], the [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|Wookiee thermal detonator trooper]],<ref name="GB" /> the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|CIS mortar super battle droid]] and the [[Clone trooper grenadier|Clone thermal detonator trooper]].<ref name="GB:CC" />
